verdict.rationale: Cognee documents `recall()` as a single-call retrieval entry point that automatically picks a search strategy. Nothing in the evidence shows it assembling a prompt-ready context block or enforcing a token budget, which are the defining parts of this story. Plain memory search is adjacent to the capability, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can retrieve a token-budgeted, prompt-ready context block assembled from relevant memories in one call
